headline: Reliance Industrial Investments discloses substantial acquisition in GTPL Hathway under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in GTPL Hathway Limited. The NSE filing confirms the formal regulatory submission but details of acquisition percentage, consideration and conditions are not yet disclosed in publicly available corroborating sources.
detail: Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings Limited, a subsidiary/holding of Reliance Industries, has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE concerning GTPL Hathway Limited, a telecom/cable distribution platform. The disclosure triggers scrutiny of whether the acquisition crosses the 25% threshold (triggering mandatory open offer) or is structured below that threshold. The full terms—share count, price, conditions and timeline—are pending corroboration from company press release, investor-relations filing or subsequent SEBI/NSE announcements.
